plainText:
Mariya Ise (Japanese: 伊瀬茉莉也 Ise Mariya) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Ise was born on September 25, 1988, in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the shortly before . Her most notable role is . From XY086 to XY100, she took a while expecting her child to be born; during that time, Mika Kanai temporarily replaced her to voice Bonnie. Ise is currently affiliated with the entertainment office .
